Ciao Luca,

ID0415510
for the charger
G0UsEh

Following up our call today, here is the the analysis of the reported issue on the charger:
The Charger had #1 event of severe toggling of Pilotstate on 27.03.2025, both on DC1 and DC2
This toggling was caused by the EcoG, which randomly had an error in parsing one config JSON file.
In this particular case, the issue appeared when the charger was not in use, hence the symptom was only a severe toggling of the outlets from A to E. In case this issue happens during a charging session, the charging itself will not be affected, but most likely the StopTransaction command will not be sent to the CPO Backend, but it will be sent only after a reboot of the charger.
As per previous point, in case this behavior happens again, a reboot will restore the charger.
As per agreed, I will monitor the charger for the next two weeks. Until now, the charger showed only once this behavior. In case the issue on EcoG begins to appear more often, the next steps could be:
Set an automatic reboot
Replace the KF11
The issue is known to both R&D and EcoG, who are working for a RCA and to identify a bugfix.
I will provide you an update as soon as possible.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
